apiKey.description: Lakera Guard API key (Bearer token). Generate one at https://platform.lakera.ai

projectId.description: Optional Lakera project ID. Uses the default policy if omitted.

endpoint.description: Lakera Guard API endpoint. Defaults to https://api.lakera.ai/v2/guard

mode.description: block = reject flagged tool calls; log = log warnings but allow execution. Defaults to block.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for Lakera API calls. Defaults to 5000.

skipTools.description: Tool names to skip screening (e.g. low-risk read-only tools).
